notes: Backend-only foundation fix. Uploaded images broke after ~1h: the brand media gallery returned a 1-hour signed R2 URL stored as-is into image_url and read with no re-signing. The R2 bucket also holds private contracts/KYC, so a public bucket is unsafe; instead we mirror the avatar/contract pattern (store key, re-sign on read) via a public GET /v1/media/assets/:id that 302-redirects to a fresh signed URL, and _enrich now returns a STABLE URL as download_url so the existing uploader stores a permanent link (no frontend change). Fixes the seller 'upload your own photo' flow + unblocks admin stock-image upload. NO migration. Backend-only → no mockup/06-diff gate. Production-impacting (Render) — surface for founder go.

release.qa_evidence: pnpm qa GREEN 79/79 + C1 GREEN (2026-06-07); no media-asset test asserted the old signed download_url.
release.deploy: 2026-06-07 — Render backend: new public GET /v1/media/assets/:id (re-sign + 302) + _enrich returns stable download_url. Auto-deploys on push. Reversible by revert. Founder go: 'pls proceed'.
release.classification: production-impacting (Render backend; new public route + download_url shape). No migration, no frontend change.
release.followup_2026-06-07: DEFECT FIX: helmet defaults Cross-Origin-Resource-Policy=same-origin on the serve responses, which blocked the frontend (inflx.in) from loading these cross-origin backend URLs → all gallery/admin images appeared broken after cutover (founder report). Fix: serveAsset + serveStockImage set CORP=cross-origin before the 302. Verified endpoints 302 to valid signed R2 URLs; no frontend CSP. Render redeploy.
